§6Uranium-235§f

§aThe fissile one. The one you actually want for fuel and bombs.§f

U-235 is the rare, fissile isotope of uranium, making up only a small fraction of natural uranium. Infamous for Little Boy, but also essential for reactor fuel.

Production: §bGas Centrifuge Cascade§f of §e4§f centrifuges processing UF6 gives §e1§f U-235 nugget + §e11§f U-238 + §e4§f fluorite per §e10§f operations (last centrifuge needs Overclocking upgrade). The §bSILEX§f can also process uranium powder, UF6, or depleted uranium fuel.

Uses: Uranium Reactor Fuel, Nuclear Warheads (gun-type bombs), and breeding chains (U-235 to Np-237 to Pu-238 for infinite RTG power). Contributes §e15§f to the custom nuke.

§ePS:§f U-235 is the gatekeeper for nuclear power. Set up a centrifuge cascade early. Switch to SILEX later for faster enrichment.
